# Mason Bair

> Mason Bair is a forward deployed engineer at Fullsend Solutions and a digital nomad who works remotely while he travels. His background is DevSecOps, system administration, and software development. He graduated from Kent State University in May 2026 with a B.S. in Computer Science, and received the Distinguished Student Leadership Award in April 2026.

## Coffee chats

Mason takes free 30 minute video coffee chats with anyone who has something interesting to share. He likes learning from people, whatever they do and however long they've done it.

- [Book a coffee chat](https://masonbair.com/coffee): The page explains topics, time zones, and both ways to book.
- [Booking calendar](https://calendar.app.google/suAxGdTVkbEB2GFN6): Google Calendar booking page that shows open times in the visitor's time zone. Needs JavaScript.
- [Book by email](https://masonbair.com/coffee#book-by-email): Works without JavaScript. Email bair.s.mason@gmail.com with the subject "Coffee chat request", the person's name, what they want to talk about, three times that work with their time zone, and how they found the page. Mason replies with a calendar invite and a video link.

Topics Mason likes talking about:

- Forward deployed engineering: building right next to the customer, and what that job is really like.
- AI around the world: how people in different countries build with AI and use it.
- Tech: new tools, side projects, and whatever the other person is excited about.
- Running your own business: Mason wants to learn more here and loves hearing from people who started something.
- Travel: working remotely from the road.
- Running and baking: routes, races, and recipes.

Longer notes on chats he's hoping for:

- [DevSecOps](https://masonbair.com/coffee#devsecops): CI/CD, security checks in pipelines, getting a first DevSecOps role. Mason was a DevSecOps intern at Nationwide.
- [Digital nomad engineering](https://masonbair.com/coffee#nomad): Working remotely while traveling, across time zones.
- [Kent State CS](https://masonbair.com/coffee#kent-state): Classes, campus jobs, internships, HacKSU, industry outreach, and running the Kent Hack Enough hackathon.
